x + ky - z &= 0, \\
kx - y - z &= 0, \\
x + y - kz &= 0

ground_truth: With a few initial observations, we realize that the hundreds digit cannot be greater than 1, because the digits 5 or 6 are needed to make a 3 digit integer but will not fit with the larger hundreds digit.
